record.question: A citizen of the world.
record.explanation: Answer A: Cosmopolitan. A cosmopolitan is at home in many countries or the world; it is the closest listed word for a world citizen. Independent check: A cosmopolitan is a citizen of the world or a person at home in many countries. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cosmopolitan.
